{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Shadow Keeper''''' was a rare model of [[Starship/Legends|starship]], of which only seven were built. The vessels were deadly space combatants, named for the fierce [[kkekkrrg rro]] creature native to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Sprax]] owned one of the vessels, and it was the most favorite ship he had in his collections.<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
